Calder v. Michigan Ex Rel. Attorney General

"But we do not inquire into the knowledge, negligence, methods or motives of the legislature if, as in this case, the repeal was passed in due form. ... The only question that we can consider is whether there is anything relevant to the present case in the terms or effect of the repeal"

National Endowment for the Arts v. Finley
"It is not consonant with our scheme of government for a court to inquire into the motives of legislators."
